set.body: Acceptance criteria: introduce a detection result that retains sample-level classes, ordered source SampleRange values, event series, detector report, and provenance while retaining Machine as the execution mechanism. GapPolicy distinguishes Break, bounded Bridge, and interpolated-only use. Every input sample and represented interval is labelled or explicitly unclassified; short discarded runs remain visible in the report; support ranges are ordered and non-overlapping where segmentation claims a partition; errors and warnings name the recording, detector, and operands.
set.title: Define complete DetectionResult with labels, gaps, and source support
